speaker: Sheldon
text: Thank you so much for giving me the opportunity to help. Hey, Penny, this is Alicia, our new neighbor. I'm helping.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Alicia's non-musical, childless, and pro-rug. She's still on probation, of course, but I like her.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, yeah, I don't usually dress like this. I'm going jogging. I can start.

speaker: Sheldon
text: True, but the more likely explanation for your attire is that you're out of clean clothes again. You're welcome, Penny.

speaker: Alicia
text: Please, you look cute. I'm dressed like a slob today, too.

speaker: Alicia
text: Thanks for the warning. I'll see you around.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Mimicry. I enjoy mimicry. I've been working on Admiral Ackbar from Return of the Jedi. It's a trap.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You have to imagine me with a giant squid head.
